title: Revisionszeichnung für die Abspülanlage der Haltestelle Reichskanzlerplatz
main_content: Revision drawing (scale 1:10) showing two elevation views (View A and View B) of the door/hatch for the washing (rinsing) installation at the Reichskanzlerplatz stop. The drawing depicts a panelled door labelled 'Tür' with handle, adjacent top-light panel noted as 'to be fitted in later', and, in View B, the connected pipes for water supply, return and venting. Overall dimensions (approx. 1.99 m wide, 0.705 m high) and the position relative to the track edge are indicated.
